clarification: The raw scope text refers broadly to worker measurement and retirement. The timestamps delimit the actual capture interval. The current controls stop capture after the prespecified 90 seconds, not at final worker retirement.
analysis_rule: Use each role's left and right timestamp brackets. Intersect their host-clock intervals. Trim two seconds from both edges.
safety_scope: Kernel inactivity is not physical idle or a decode-safe executable window. DMA is not captured by this kernel-only collector.
